settings.headline: Low Tide
settings.subtitle: Three days, four stages and 36 artists on a sandy point between the bay and the dunes. The sun sets behind the main stage every night.

settings.headline: Thirty-six artists,
settings.subtitle: Headliners close the Tidepool Main Stage every night at 9:30 pm. The Kelp Forest keeps going until 12:30 am.

settings.headline: Sets people will
settings.subtitle: Tap the star to add a set to your schedule. Your picks stay in this browser.

settings.headline: Pick a stage,
settings.subtitle: The furthest two stages are an eight-minute walk apart, so you can catch a bit of everything.

settings.headline: Everything you need
settings.subtitle: Shuttles, hours, what to bring and how we make the weekend work for everyone.

items.title: Free shuttles
items.text: Every 10 minutes from Halcyon Bay station, 11 am until 1:30 am. Or walk the boardwalk to the Beach Gate.

items.title: Gates at noon
items.text: First sets at 2:30 pm, headliners at 9:30 pm, and the Kelp Forest runs until 12:30 am.

items.title: Access for everyone
items.text: Matting on main paths, a viewing platform, free companion tickets and ASL at every headline set.
